top_signals.title: Moody’s Warns of Deeper Losses for Bondholders in Senegal Revamp
top_signals.summary: Moody’s Ratings warned that bondholders could face wider-than-expected losses as Senegal seeks to rework billions of dollars of external debt, as it downgraded the West African nation’s credit rating.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Tesco Strikes €1.7 Billion Deal to Sell Czech, Slovakia Unit
top_signals.summary: Tesco Plc agreed to sell its supermarket division in the Czech Republic and Slovakia to Ahold Delhaize for an enterprise value of €1.7 billion (£1.5 billion), marking the end of a once ambitious plan to become a global grocery giant.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
